name: v03-shell-after
what: tools/bench/src/accept-fly.ts B6-B17 (file unchanged), run locally against the Vite dev server of this commit, for the v0.3 wave 1 app-shell refactor (W1-2): same pass/fail and numbers within noise before and after

run.server: vite dev server of apps/fly at this commit, http://127.0.0.1:5312 (LOCAL_FLY=1, SITE=http://127.0.0.1:5312)
run.driver: a verbatim copy of accept-fly.ts and evidence.ts in a gitignored runner dir; browser.ts launch() swapped for the preinstalled Playwright Chromium (/opt/pw-browsers/chromium, Chromium 141) headful under xvfb-run (no system Chrome, no display); same viewport, no extra flags; GSFPV_REPO pointed at a scratch dir so the committed evidence/2026-09-27/b-fly-*.json were not overwritten

env.gpu: none: WebGPU has no adapter, WebGL runs in SwiftShader (software), the scan renders at about 1 frame/s after load

limits.B6: renderer 1 (WebGL) instead of 2 (WebGPU GPU sort): no WebGPU adapter here; data: and blob: requests show as host "" (outside the allow-list); the two error pages come up in English, not Russian (LOCAL_FLY has no locale path)
limits.B7: LOCAL_FLY serves /fly/ without the locale path, so es/pl/ru pages come up in English (en rows and the control pass)
limits.B8: no Firefox build installed (/opt/pw-browsers has Chromium only); history, filter and the no-WebGPU shim parts pass
limits.B10: the simulated person does not finish the calibration wizard in the 60 s the harness allows at about 1 frame/s (step 2 of 6)
limits.B11: follows B10: no profile saved, the gate says noProfile
limits.B12: the bot does not crash within the 120 s wait (physics at about 56 steps per wall second, B15): the harness throws at the Respawn click and stops; the DOM walk covers crash panel and Respawn with a 10 min wait
limits.B14: the 10 s hover controller runs against a sim at about 0.06x real time: the craft settles and counts as crashed
limits.B15: replay hashes match in a new tab (pass part), but steps per wall second are about 56, not 1000
limits.B17: no crash within the N x 40 s = 120 s the harness allows (B17_CRASHES=3); one bot crash took 451 s here even at render scale 0.25 (the DOM walk, starting commit)

dataActionTestid.method: static scan of apps/fly sources: literal and template values of data-action / data-testid, plus the pause menu ids

after.source: app/builtin/*.ts ctx.menu.add({ id, order }) sorted by order (data-action = it.id)

domWalk.method: runner dom-walk.ts (a scratch script, not committed; its steps are the rows): warning, picker, flight view, walls menu, pause menu and each screen it opens then Esc, P over a panel, top Pause/Continue/Controls, Controls over the menu, V (x3), C (x2), H (x2), F3, R, R in the menu, Esc opens/continues, P R typed in the import text field then Esc, P and Esc over the drone picker, a hidden tab, then a bot crash, the crash panel and Respawn; render scale 0.25 and DOM clicks (CDP mouse clicks stalled at 1 frame/s), the same for both sides
domWalk.comparedPerStep: data-action and data-testid sets, paused, panel count, screens, #ui classes (minus hud-flying), order of #ui children, pause menu (actions, caps, aria-keyshortcuts, labels, disabled), frame line, walls on/off, voxel mode, crashed
